name: czrecoilframe_ensure_hw_api_initialized
description: CZRecoilFrame::EnsureHwApiInitialized initializes the selected hardware API slot or fallback mode, then clears the other hardware API command UI states.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4316c0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4316c0 validates early return for already-initialized slots, fallback initialization for selector 0, hardware initialization through SetHwApiAndInitMode(selector - 1), and clearing all other m_hwApiCmdUiState entries.
The native smoke verifies the already-initialized fallback selector is left unchanged and selector 2 initializes hardware API index 1 while clearing sibling command UI states.
